case_number: 2025 INSC 14; Civil Appeal Nos. of 2025 (@ SLP (C) Nos. 10558-59 of 2024)
summary: Adoption and inheritance rights; validity of sale and gift deeds; ownership after partition decree; defendant No.1's 9/32 share from compromise decree; adoption by defendant No.1 not vesting half share in appellant; sale deed for schedule A upheld; gift deed for B and C set aside by trial court but restored by High Court; High Court reverses trial court, dismisses appellant's RFA, allows respondents' RFA, sets aside partial decree; appeal before Supreme Court challenging High Court's restoration of gift deed and dismissal of suit; issues: heirship, competence of defendant No.1 to sell/gift, binding nature of deeds.
